Asha (Sales): Heads-up: AtlasBank POC — fully air-gapped, strict audit. They require signed bundles, CycloneDX SBOM (not SPDX), monthly patches, emergency sneakernet process, tamper-evident manifest, and TPM-based key attestation. Asking for fixed per-patch pricing and SOW language.
Tom (Solutions): We can do minibundles; propose two flows: monthly delta stream or quarterly full + monthly deltas. For this customer, they want per-USB delivery and a tamper-evident manifest label in addition to detached sig.
Marta (Security): Security asks: CycloneDX SBOM included per bundle, detached signature (we can support TPM attestation and customer HSM), offline verifier binary, and manifest with signed SHA512 checksums. If Redwood signs, customer requires key attestation report.
Irfan (Eng): Technical constraints: we support delta chunking up to 2GB per chunk (customer prefers 2GB to match their USB sticks). Deltas require previous runtime state to avoid cold restart. We'll provide a verifier that checks signatures, SBOM hashes, and TPM quote. Example verify command:
```
./rw-verify --bundle bundle.tar.gz --sig bundle.sig --sbom bundle.cdx.json --tpm-quote quote.bin
```
Becky (Ops): Ops SOW notes: maintenance window 60-120 mins for standard delta apply. Retain last 5 bundles (they want longer retention). Rollback preserved 7 days for audit. Customer responsible for chain-of-custody; Redwood supplies a transfer checklist and verification tools. Hotfix SLA: 72h standard; same-day as paid expedited.

Asha (Sales): Pricing: they want a per-patch fixed line. I suggest: one-time sealed-bundle engineering $12k, per-patch handling & signing $4k, emergency hotfix premium $8k, expedited SLA +$5k/mo. Thoughts?
Tom (Solutions): Numbers look reasonable for enterprise finance teams. Also add optional PS for HSM/TPM integration during bootstrap.
Marta (Security): Note: TPM attestation will need onsite access to run quotes during bootstrap; call out as PS in SOW. Also FIPS/TLS requirements may add 1-2 weeks.
Irfan (Eng): We'll produce manifest schema and verifier binary. Also include a tiny sample manifest in SOW appendix.
Becky (Ops): Action items: Tom to draft SOW + pricing lines; Marta to fill security questionnaire and attach CycloneDX template; Irfan to deliver manifest + verifier; Becky to write transfer checklist + runbook snippet. Asha to confirm USB capacity and audit retention with AtlasBank.
Asha (Sales): Thanks — will sync with AtlasBank and loop in Legal after draft. Please flag any blockers here.
